IDENT.title: A framework for manufacturing system reconfiguration and optimisation utilising digital twins and modular artificial intelligence

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__dt_definiti.value: the digital twin (DT), which is a virtual representation of a physical asset, dynamically exchanging data with the 'physical twin'.
DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__dt_definiti.evidence_quote: The first is the digital twin (DT), which is a virtual representation of a physical asset, dynamically exchanging data with the ‘‘physical twin’’.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_replic.evidence_quote: This scenario is based on a real reconfigurable robotic manufacturing cell at the University of Nottingham.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_synchr.evidence_quote: The simulation environment is created based on the result from the reconfiguration stage 1 and the information from the real equipment.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_purpos.evidence_quote: the methodology proposed in this paper can be used to determine the optimum locations for robots in simulation

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__purpose_des.value: Simulation-based reconfiguration optimisation of a robotic cell (robot selection and locations to minimise operation time without collisions).
DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__purpose_des.evidence_quote: Here, total operation time and collision status are used as the KPIs to minimise.

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_incorp.evidence_quote: using Siemens Tecnomatix Process Simulate as the digital twin enabler alongside a knowledge graph to store data

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_subjec.evidence_quote: Based on the MRKG and the engineer’s experience, evaluators are defined and used to select the most suitable assets

DT_A_DEFINITION_CONFORMANCE__conf_data_h.evidence_quote: All the manufacturing data (current system configuration and historical data) is stored in graph format in Neo4j

DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__output_type.evidence_quote: the output value generated from the simulation environment is the process time for the operation or a high failure value

DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__output_metric_descri.value: Total operation time (s) and collision status; 35.40 s baseline reduced to 32.01 s (9.58%).
DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__output_metric_descri.evidence_quote: Compared with the baseline (35.40 s), they have reduced the time by 9.58%, 9.58% and 9.52%, respectively.

DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__simulatable_forward_.evidence_quote: the updated robot parameter will be sent to the simulation environment to get a new operation time and then check for collisions

DT_B_OUTPUT_AND_UQ__model_extractable_by.evidence_quote: The simulation environment will send information to the optimisation environment through a socket based on the Tecnomatix .NET API.

DT_C_CONSTRUCTION_AND_UPDATE__sme_involv.evidence_quote: a simulation environment should be generated based on the bill of process from the product requirement and the bill of resources from reconfiguration stage 1, either automatically or manually

DT_C_CONSTRUCTION_AND_UPDATE__model_upda.evidence_quote: The real equipment data can also be used to improve the performance of the simulation environment.

DT_C_CONSTRUCTION_AND_UPDATE__reuse_or_t.evidence_quote: provide a framework that can be used for a wide variety of manufacturing applications

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__dt_agent_coupli.evidence_quote: Embedded in the DT is an artificial intelligence-driven data pipeline that allows the asset model, and consequently the real one, to improve the decision-making capabilities

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__dt_makes_decisi.evidence_quote: the simulation environment is used to test the results

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__spatial_represe.evidence_quote: a simulation environment is built in Siemens Tecnomatix Process Simulate, which consists of two KUKA KR 270 R2700 ultra robots

DT_D_AGENT_RELATIONSHIP__part_vs_resourc.evidence_quote: The part will be transported by conveyor to robot 1 for picking.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: a simulation environment is built in Siemens Tecnomatix Process Simulate

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: the baseline of the total operation time is 35.40 s.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: the customer wants a welded rod product with a specific dimension
